title: Retailer best practices for AI-powered Performance Max campaigns - Google Ads Help - Accelerate with Google US

facts.fact: During the 2022 holiday season, 55% of shoppers used five or more channels to shop over a two-day period, according to Google's cited source.
facts.quote: During the 2022 holiday season, 55% of shoppers used five or more channels, ranging from video to social media, to shop over a two-day period.

facts.fact: Advertisers that shifted from Standard Shopping campaigns to Performance Max drove a 25% increase in conversion value on average at a similar ROAS, per Google's claim.
facts.quote: Advertisers that have shifted from Standard Shopping campaigns to Performance Max drove a 25% increase in conversion value, on average, at a similar ROAS.

facts.fact: Performance Planner's forecasts are adjusted for seasonal events so advertisers can explore conversion opportunities during key moments like holiday.
facts.quote: Performance Planner’s forecasts are also adjusted for seasonal events so you can explore conversion opportunities during key moments like holiday.

facts.fact: Google recommends providing transaction-specific conversion values for each conversion for retailers whose customers purchase items at different prices and who want to maximize total revenue.
facts.quote: For retailers, we strongly recommend providing transaction-specific values for each conversion if your customers are purchasing items with different prices and you want to maximize total revenue.

facts.fact: The guide's best practices are aimed at retail marketers running Performance Max campaigns with a Google Merchant Center feed.
facts.quote: We’ve created these best practices for retail marketers who are running Performance Max campaigns with a Google Merchant Center feed.

facts.fact: Performance Max campaigns can be configured to optimize towards online sales, store sales, or omnichannel sales.
facts.quote: Performance Max campaigns are goal-based and can be configured to optimize towards online sales, store sales, or omnichannel sales.

facts.fact: Google's one-click experiments automatically create a new Performance Max campaign from an existing Standard Shopping campaign for A/B testing.
facts.quote: With new one-click experiments, it’s now easier than ever to set up an A/B test that will automatically create a new Performance Max campaign from an existing Standard Shopping campaign.

facts.fact: Google recommends using seasonality adjustments for short, infrequent events where a conversion rate change of more than 30% is expected within a window of less than 7 days.
facts.unit: % change in conversion rate over <7 days
facts.quote: Seasonality adjustments are a great tool for short, infrequent events, where you expect a significant change (e.g. >30%) in conversion rates over a narrow time window (<7 days).

facts.fact: Seasonality adjustments require conversion history, so they should only be used on existing campaigns.
facts.quote: Because conversion history is required, seasonal adjustments should only be used on existing campaigns.

facts.fact: Google recommends manually adjusting ROAS or CPA targets instead of seasonality adjustments for longer promotions or smaller expected conversion rate changes.
facts.quote: If you are running a longer promotion or expect a smaller conversion rate change, we recommend manually adjusting ROAS or CPA targets to help Smart Bidding accommodate the seasonality.

facts.fact: New holiday-specific assets and asset groups should be uploaded at least 2 weeks before they are needed so they can be approved.
facts.quote: New holiday assets and asset groups should be uploaded at least 2 weeks in advance to make sure they’re approved.

facts.fact: Final URL expansion is not available to Performance Max campaigns that only optimize to store goals.
facts.quote: Note: Final URL expansion is not available to campaigns that only optimize to store goals.

facts.fact: For store goals, Google requires the full range of creative assets, including text headlines, descriptions, images, logos, video, calls-to-action, business name and a final URL.
facts.quote: If you’re optimizing to store goals, you must include the full range of creative assets: text headlines, descriptions, images, logos, video, calls-to-action, business name and a final URL.

facts.fact: If an advertiser does not provide its own video creative, Performance Max may auto-generate one or more videos drawing from existing text assets, images, and the product feed.
facts.quote: If you do not provide your own video creative, then one or more videos may be auto-generated to help you drive more conversions from this inventory.

facts.fact: Google/Ipsos Holiday Shopping Study (Oct 13 2022 to Jan 4 2023) was an online survey of US Americans aged 18+ who did holiday shopping in the past two days, with a sample of n=8,467.
facts.quote: Source: Google/Ipsos, Holiday Shopping Study, Oct 13 2022 – Jan 4 2023, Online survey, US, n=8,467, Americans 18+ who conducted holiday shopping activities in past two days.

facts.fact: The Google/Kantar Budget Agility and Channel Desiloing Research (March to June 2022, across US, CA, AU, BR, DE, IN, JP, UK) had 416 advertisers classed as Agile.
facts.quote: Google/Kantar Budget Agility and Channel Desiloing Research, US, CA, AU, BR, DE, IN, JP, UK, March 2022 - June 2022. Advertiser: Agile n=416, Not Agile n=1677.

facts.fact: Google Data for Global Ads covers October 2022 to March 2023, as cited in footnote 2 of the page.
facts.quote: Google Data, Global, Ads, October 2022 - March 2023.

facts.fact: Google Data for Global Ads covers February to April 2023, as cited in footnote 5 of the page.
facts.quote: 5. Google Data, Global Ads, February - April 2023.

facts.fact: A Google global data source cited on the page is dated November 2022.
facts.quote: 4. Google data, Global, November 2022.

facts.fact: Google Ads Ad Strength rates asset quality as “low,” “good,” or “best,” and advertisers can swap lower-quality assets once they reach the maximum number of assets.
facts.quote: see if your asset quality is “low,” “good,” or “best,” and whether you need to add new assets for Google AI to use in your creative.
